title: Buddy Bolden's band and how he played
summary: He remembers the loud ragtime and blues of the Bolden band and watching it as a boy with his mouth open.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: I'm, I'm, I'm not going to cut you off, but when you were, when you were just young in the music, just starting in the music, can you remember any of the other bands they had around here? Press talks about the, uh, Bollin.
Bollin, Bollin, Bollin, yes. Oh yes, Bollin band, well that was, that was about the best band most, them times. In them times. And then the, the trumpet. How did Bollin play?

Oh yeah, oh yeah, it was ragtime, that was ragtime, ragtime, ragtime, you know, all them blues and everything like that. Loud, you could hear him. Four o'clock in the morning, you could hear him cross the road. Yeah, yeah. It was just loud, you know, playing like, didn't care, you know. Just didn't care? Didn't care, you know, them fellas. He just hit the notes all right.
He just hit the notes. Oh yeah.

Yeah, I never did see him read a piece of music though. Well, one time I went to see him play at the, at the old fellas hall, and I sit down there, and I sit down there, I sit down there, and the first time I went in there, looking at him and Carnish, and Buddy, Bollin, and Bob Lyons, all of the players. I sit down there, but I must be having my mouth open. And sitting down there, you know, I had my mouth open looking at them playing. But after I got up from playing, I must have had dust in here. I did like that, man, I couldn't hardly have to swallow all that dust. Then that was my mouth open looking at them.
Oh yeah, you've been just so interested.

Yeah. I sit down there looking at them, the first time I'd been close to him playing, you understand. I sit down there, and I was a lad, just start the playing. And I just sat there, I must be with my mouth open, and I must have swallowed all that dust. Yeah, it does smell like dust. Yeah, you know. And I did like that. You didn't get your breath. You did. I must have swallowed some dust down there. And so they went, afterwards they went crazy, you know. Did he play anything like your band playing? Who?
Did Golden, did he play in a similar style to your band, or?

Well, yes, they all played the same thing, like you don't shake, you don't get no kick, you know, such a thing. They used to play all that. All that stuff, we'll hear that fella play. We'll play, we'll catch and play, we'll catch our band, we'll play it you see. And we'll see the other fella playing something good, right? Right, right, we'll catch it and we'll play it. You catch it from one another, you understand.
